name: Summoner’s Mark
body:
School conjuration; Level summoner 1

CASTING

Casting Time standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft. per caster level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A successful ranged touch attack transfers a glowing rune to the target’s forehead. While the rune remains (for this spell’s duration), all creatures you have summoned receive a +1 competence bonus to attack the target.
